title: The Voices Beneath the Water · Episode 3: The Water We Promise
description: Three preparations before the storm. Balance lives, fair access and tomorrow’s water; your promises and preparations determine who survives and who holds power.

sources.title: Original continuation
sources.note: David approved the competing-values, three-preparation, binding-promise and outcome-scorecard plan on 2026-10-27.

notice: An original Star Wars fan adventure. You play Jonathan. Includes non-graphic death and lasting consequences. Select your actual Episode 2 ending at the start; it is not imported automatically. Decisions use preparation opportunities, not reading time. End scores describe lives, fairness and future security, not your moral worth. Accept to begin.

planning.sourceBoundary: Return from Neri; two-community water negotiation. End before departure to investigate the damaged landscape.
planning.dramaticChange: Informed choices alter survival, control of the pump and cooperation. Three preparations unlock a costly shared agreement.
planning.englishNarrationPurpose: Contextual help and outcome scorecard only.

choicesAndCallbacks.laterPayoff: Shared agreement requires pump and listening; evacuation saves Mei; reserve adds four buckets.

choicesAndCallbacks.response: Two buckets arrive only with a priority promise.
choicesAndCallbacks.laterPayoff: Keep, break or renegotiate by consent.

sceneActivities.purpose: Jonathan inspects on his knees; escorts Min toward safety; An stands away when recalling concealment.

planning.teaser: Jonathan holds one flask between two reaching hands at the agreement decision; unresolved action only, no speech.
planning.payoff: Storm survives; agreement and medical outcome settled.

planning.pinyinReview: Reviewed all 70 unique lines and chunk pinyin. Corrected 妻子, 管子, 答应, return 还, 地方, numeral readings and Latin names. Digits are consistent with visible resource quantities; source inventory unchanged.
planning.vocabularyReview: Simplified original dialogue against the unchanged 388-word supplied inventory/glossary. Approximately 87–89% membership, not assessed mastery. Retained essential new storm, bucket, medical and crack vocabulary with full help.

continuation.end: Two-community water negotiation ends in hill control, temporary need-based distribution, or earned shared management. Mei survives only with evacuation or treatment. Earlier casualties and An’s independent testimony persist.
continuation.nextStart: Episode 4: departure to investigate the cracked landscape; explicitly restore the Episode 3 agreement, survivors and remaining water.
continuation.nextEndBefore: Do not reveal the voice artifact or deep reserve until a later planned discovery.
continuation.note: No universal ending; preserve agreement, medical outcome, inherited casualties and promise consequences.
continuity: The child from episode 1 is safe with her mother.
Jonathan, An and Q travel to Neri for water; Min is an adult with an ill wife; Tao is the pump worker.
Episode 2 has four outcomes: Tao dead/all water/Q alive; everyone alive/half water; everyone alive/no water/Tao offers a lead; Tao alive/all water/Q destroyed and recording lost.
An agrees to answer publicly alongside Jonathan if he tells the truth; she refuses to support concealment and gives her own account.
The source of the repeated voice remains unexplained. Do not resurrect Tao or Q or restore the lost recording without an explicitly selected compatible route.

Episode 3: three preparations from pump inspection, both-community hearing, voluntary household reserve contribution and evacuation. Shared management requires inspection and hearing and costs four buckets.
Mei survives only if evacuated early or treated with four buckets; otherwise she dies. Do not resurrect her.
Hill control costs six buckets; emergency distribution breaks a prior promise if made; shared management renegotiates it by consent. Carry the actual agreement and remaining water forward.

teaser.reference: Built-in ImageGen first, using approved anime Jonathan reference. Original user photo remains private.
teaser.imagePrompt: Shonen anime Jonathan holds one sealed flask between two reaching hands; An watches; storm approaches; no outcome revealed.
teaser.prompt: Animate this exact anime image. Preserve Jonathan and An and both hands. One continuous six-second shot. Jonathan slowly draws the sealed flask closer to his chest, hesitating between the two reaching hands; he does not hand it to either side. An watches quietly. Subtle cloth movement in a rising wind and distant storm light. The adult hands pause. No new people, no Q or Tao, no injury, no cuts, no zoom, no resolution. Native audio only wind, a faint metal flask creak and distant thunder. No speech, narration, voices, music or text. Keep every mouth closed. Maintain the reference faces, proportions, clothing and crisp shonen linework.

englishAudioOverrides.text: On Neri, I told the truth.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: I promised to answer alongside you. That remains true today.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: I did not lie for you. Today I answer for myself.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: The people on the hill and those beside the river are waiting for water. There were four buckets here already.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: The storm is coming. We can do three tasks. Then we must return.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Read slowly, Think carefully. There is no reading time limit.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: My wife Mei is seriously ill. Take her uphill first. The doctor has medicine and clean water.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: If she stays here, she needs four buckets tonight. Without enough water, she will die.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: She needs drinking water. Her wounds need washing and the sickroom must be clean.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Three preparation opportunities remain.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Inspect the pump. Learn why it failed.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Hear both communities. Consider shared management.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Investigate the concealed water. It may add four buckets.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Give the pump four buckets to flush out the sand. Then it can be repaired. It will yield water tomorrow.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: The hill community built and maintains the pump. The river community repairs the pipes. They need to work together.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Inspect together, distribute water together, show everyone the records, would that work?
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Both sides are willing. But the pump must be repaired first.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: They fear having no water tomorrow. We must remember who gave it.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: I record who contributed. They agree to share four buckets with everyone.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: The doctor has received her. There is enough water and medicine. She is safe tonight.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Two preparation opportunities remain.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Their children need water. But river residents have no choice.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Promise their first claim to six buckets and control of the pump. They give two buckets now.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Do not promise. They do not contribute two buckets, but we can still negotiate.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: I recorded your promise. If it changes later, explain why.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: They take the two buckets away. We can still talk, but those two buckets are not here.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: I hold the flask. People on both sides reach out. This one flask cannot be promised to both.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Mei is still below. She needs four buckets. Without enough, she will die.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: You inspected the pump and heard both communities. They agree to manage it together but first four buckets must repair the pump.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: They agree to cancel the six-bucket priority. The two buckets already contributed need not be returned.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Distribute by need first. Do not grant exclusive pump control. They may stop trusting me.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Spend four buckets on repairs. Both communities manage it together.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: There are fewer than six buckets. We cannot promise six.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: We have no shared repair plan. Saying we will manage it together is not enough.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: They receive six buckets. They promise repairs tomorrow. But river residents cannot decide.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: You changed your promise. They do not reclaim the two buckets, but refuse further repair help.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: We broke no promise. Tonight, water goes to those who need it. Who repairs the pipes tomorrow? That remains unsettled.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Both sides agree to shared management. Everyone can inspect the records. The hill community cannot decide alone.

englishAudioOverrides.text: She is still waiting. Four buckets can save her. But tomorrow there will be four fewer.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Give Mei four buckets. Save her. Look for water again tomorrow.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.
